notes:
Lead: Sarah Park (Product) + CTO: Rafael Gomez. Mid-market SaaS onboarding/product team building in-app guided copilots to reduce time-to-first-value.
- Goal: lightweight in-app copilot for new user onboarding flows (guided steps, contextual hints, step completion confirmations).
- Starting with Hosted API POC to validate streaming latency, tool-calling reliability (calendar, user-profile fetch), and token caps per session.
- Latency SLO: target median streaming chunk <300ms, end-to-end response <1.5s for common flows (short prompts). Product quote: "Users drop off if flow >2s, must be snappy."
- Cost constraints: strict token budget per onboarding session (token caps + alerts). Need config to enforce per-session token caps and fallback messaging when exceeded.
- Reliability: expect graceful degradation to smaller model or cached responses if latency spikes. Interested in Redwood routing/fallback features.
- Security: require SSO + audit logs, KMS for key management, data residency for EU customers. Early ask: SOC2 compliance evidence and KMS integration pattern docs.
- POC scope: 2-week hosted POC with synthetic load (200 concurrent onboarding flows) -> measure latency distribution, streaming stability, tool-call success rate. If meets SLO, run Dedicated pricing scenario for committed monthly throughput and burst.
- Pricing sensitivity: price-per-token vs committed capacity math — finance wants modeled TCO for 6-12 month ramp.
- Notes from 2026-02-18 technical call with SE Daniel: tested streaming on sample flow, saw tail spikes during multi-tool calls (calendar + profile lookup). SE recommended prefix caching and KV cache suggested config.
- Quote from CTO Rafael: "If Dedicated buys down cost and guarantees p95 latency, we can move to commit. But need transparent fallback rules and rollout controls."
- Internal stakeholders: Product (Sarah), Engineering (Rafael), Security (Maya Li), Finance (Tom Reed).
- Docs shared: pricing deck, security Q&A. Next show: Dedicated sizing + cost model if POC passes.
